TN Minister Clarifies Chicken Biryani in Midday Meals

Tamil Nadu's School Education Minister has clarified a proposal to include chicken biryani in the state's midday meal scheme. The clarification addresses concerns and details regarding the implementation of this dietary addition for students. The minister's statement aimed to provide specific information about the proposal's scope and purpose.
